jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(D) inventory: Rutland City Supervisory District -- the Rutland City School District, a city school district and its own supervisory district, governed by its Board of School Commissioners under the Rutland city charter (24 App. V.S.A. ch. 9, subchapter 030). Operates PK-12.

board.org_name: Rutland City Board of School Commissioners
board.post_note: Rutland City: eleven school commissioners elected at large at the annual city election for staggered three-year terms (charter section 30.1); vacancies are filled until the next annual election on mayoral nomination (charter section 30.2).

sources.note: Rutland City Board of School Commissioners reorganization minutes, March 17, 2026 (official): the Mayor administered the oath to four ELECTED commissioners for three-year terms -- Brandi Barclay, Courtney Collins Whitcomb, Herbert Ogden, Jennifer Rondinone (terms to March 2029); continuing members with published terms (FY2025 City Annual Report): Bossi 2028, Lennox-Levins 2028, Seward 2027, Stoodley 2027, Sweet 2027. Item C: the Mayor recommended Ryan Carney and Cathy Solsaa "to fill the two vacant school board seats for a term ending March 2027" under charter section 30.2; the April 14, 2026 agenda carries the section 30.2 vote and oath (both "Term Expires 3/2027"), and both sit in the May 2026 minutes -- the appointments took effect. Dena Goldberg and Lauren Weiss finished their terms in March 2026 (March 10, 2026 minutes); the minutes' "stepping in when needed" phrasing indicates they were themselves earlier section 30.2 appointees -- their seating documentation was not fetched and no ended records are minted for them.
